title.en: Convert binary, octal and hexadecimal numbers to decimal

say.en: A website colour code says 7D for green. How much green is that out of 255? Let us convert it to decimal. In this lesson: Convert binary, octal and hexadecimal numbers to decimal.
Convert binary fractions to decimal.

body.en: To convert a number in base b to decimal, multiply each digit by its *place* value (b raised to its position) and add the products. Positions to the left of the point are 0, 1, 2, … and those to the right are −1, −2, … For example, $(101.101)_2 = 4 + 0 + 1 + 0.5 + 0 + 0.125 = 5.625$.

Positions to the left of the point are 0, 1, 2,... and those to the right are minus 1, minus 2,... For example, 101.101 2 equals 4 plus 0 plus 1 plus 0.5 plus 0 plus 0.125 equals 5.625. title.en: On the board: Converting to decimal by place values

say.en: Write the place values under each digit. Left of the point they are 1, 2, 4; right of it they are a half, a quarter, an eighth.
Multiply and add: 4 plus 1 plus 0.5 plus 0.125 gives 5.625.
Octal works the same way with powers of 8.
Hexadecimal uses powers of 16, and A stands for 10.
A hex fraction digit is worth one sixteenth: 3A.8 is 58 plus 8 sixteenths, that is 58.5.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Convert (101101)₂, (257)₈ and (1AF)₁₆ to decimal.

say.en: Let us work through this together. Convert 101101 2, 257 8 and 1AF 16 to decimal.
101101 2 equals 32 plus 0 plus 8 plus 4 plus 0 plus 1 equals 45.
257 8 equals 2 times 64 plus 5 times 8 plus 7 equals 128 plus 40 plus 7 equals 175.
1AF 16 equals 1 times 256 plus 10 times 16 plus 15 equals 256 plus 160 plus 15 equals 431.
So the answer is 45, 175 and 431.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Convert (1011.101)₂ to decimal.

say.en: Let us work through this together. Convert 1011.101 2 to decimal.
Integer part: 8 plus 0 plus 2 plus 1 equals 11.
Fraction part: 1 times one half plus 0 times one quarter plus 1 times ⅛ equals 0.5 plus 0.125 equals 0.625.
Total equals 11 plus 0.625.
So the answer is 1011.101 2 equals 11.625 10.
